recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical composition featuring four men in light-colored suits walking toward the viewer on a dark, reflective surface at night, with a mirrored reflection below and thin, geometric gold-toned typography floating above.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical symmetry between the subjects and their reflections
Contrast between the bright suits and the dark, bokeh-lit night background
Integration of thin-line typography with the upper negative space
Horizontal alignment of the four figures creating a rhythmic pace
coreInvariants: High-contrast night photography with city light bokeh

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four figures centered horizontally in the middle third, with their reflections occupying the bottom third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central group of four men in high-value light suits.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright suits, move down to the reflection, then up to the large geometric title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant dark space at the top and bottom edges, providing room for typography and reflections.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark charcoal for the night background and reflective floor.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale lavender or off-white for the suits to pop against the dark.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow for the typography and warm bokeh city lights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the subjects and the background.

letterConstructionRules: Vertical orientation for small connecting words
Overlapping characters to create a unified graphic block
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' is an oversized perfect circle
Lowercase 'i' and 'n' are stacked vertically to the left of the main text

composition.relationshipToImage: Floats in the dark sky area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A single geometric display face used in varying sizes and orientations.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric 70s soul aesthetic and tight kerning possibilities.
Provides the necessary geometric circularity and thin stroke.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Photograph four men in matching light-colored 70s style suits walking forward on a wet, black reflective surface at night. The background should be a dark city skyline with soft, out-of-focus bokeh lights. Mirror the image vertically at the feet of the men.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply thin, golden geometric sans-serif lettering in the upper right quadrant. Use large circular forms for capitals and stack smaller connecting words vertically to the left of the main title.

verificationChecks: Are the suits the brightest element in the image?
Is the typography hairline thin and geometric?
Is the background dark enough to allow the gold text to be legible?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the reflection matches the subjects' poses exactly.
Check that the typography does not obscure the subjects' heads.
Verify the gold color of the text feels metallic or luminous.
Confirm the bokeh lights are soft and do not draw focus away from the center.
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical night photography + light-colored suits + reflective floor + hairline geometric typography.
